## 1. Make the OG1 files

On the Glider Rodeo JupyterHub, in a clone of the hackathon shared repository on the
`ehsan-abdi` branch:

```bash
pip install -r glider-og1/requirements.txt
python glider-og1/convert.py --data-dir ~/shared-public/GliderRodeo --out-dir ~/og1 --all
```

This writes one `<platform_serial>_<start>_delayed.nc` file per glider and checks each against the OG1 specification.
